# What do you actually keep from your freelance work?

> Free analyzer for freelancers: drop in your Upwork transaction history CSV and see the service fee you actually paid, Connects, membership and withdrawal costs, what you keep by contract and by month, and net pay per hour. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
